components.name: Settings Toolbar Trigger
components.description: Compact icon-only entry point that expands to a 40px mobile target.
components.html: <button class="ds-settings-trigger" type="button" aria-label="Settings" title="Settings"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 20 20"><path d="M7.5 3.8h9M3.5 3.8h1.4M12.5 10h4M3.5 10h6.4M9.5 16.2h7M3.5 16.2h3.4"/><circle cx="6.2" cy="3.8" r="1.3"/><circle cx="11.2" cy="10" r="1.3"/><circle cx="8.2" cy="16.2" r="1.3"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-settings-trigger { width: 28px; min-height: 28px; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--studio-border) 72%, transparent); border-radius: var(--studio-radius-sm); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--studio-control) 68%, transparent); color: var(--studio-text-secondary); cursor: pointer; } .ds-settings-trigger svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.45; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-settings-trigger:hover { background: var(--studio-control-hover); color: var(--studio-text); } .ds-settings-trigger:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--studio-focus); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-settings-trigger:active { transform: translateY(1px); } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-settings-trigger { width: 40px; min-height: 40px; } }

components.name: Settings Dialog Shell
components.description: Centered modal with a restrained title bar and viewport-aware dimensions.
components.html:
Settings

Settings content
components.css: .ds-settings-dialog { width: min(780px, calc(100vw - 40px)); height: min(460px, calc(100vh - 40px)); overflow: hidden; display: grid; grid-template-rows: 52px minmax(0, 1fr); border: 1px solid var(--studio-border); border-radius: var(--studio-radius-lg); background: var(--studio-panel); color: var(--studio-text); box-shadow: var(--studio-shadow-panel); font-family: var(--studio-font-sans); } .ds-settings-dialog header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 14px 0 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--studio-border); background: var(--studio-panel-raised); } .ds-settings-dialog h2 { margin: 0; font-size: var(--studio-font-size-xl); line-height: 20px; letter-spacing: -.01em; } .ds-settings-dialog header button { width: 28px; min-height: 28px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: var(--studio-radius-sm); background: transparent; color: var(--studio-text-secondary); cursor: pointer; } .ds-settings-dialog header button:hover { background: var(--studio-control-hover); color: var(--studio-text); } .ds-settings-dialog header button:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--studio-focus); } .ds-settings-dialog header svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-settings-dialog-body { padding: 22px 26px 30px; background: var(--studio-panel-raised); color: var(--studio-text-secondary); font-size: var(--studio-font-size-md); } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-settings-dialog { width: calc(100vw - 20px); height: min(500px, calc(100vh - 20px)); grid-template-rows: 48px minmax(0, 1fr); } .ds-settings-dialog header { padding-inline: 14px 10px; } .ds-settings-dialog header button { width: 40px; min-height: 40px; } .ds-settings-dialog-body { padding: 18px 14px 24px; } }

components.name: Settings Section Navigation
components.description: Vertical desktop tabs that become horizontal at the compact breakpoint.
components.css: .ds-settings-nav { width: 174px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; padding: 12px 10px; border-right: 1px solid var(--studio-border); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--studio-control) 48%, var(--studio-panel)); font-family: var(--studio-font-sans); } .ds-settings-nav button { min-height: 34px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--studio-radius-sm); background: transparent; color: var(--studio-text-secondary); font-size: var(--studio-font-size-md); font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-settings-nav button:hover { background: var(--studio-control-hover); color: var(--studio-text); } .ds-settings-nav button[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--studio-control-pressed); color: var(--studio-text); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--studio-border) 65%, transparent); } .ds-settings-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--studio-focus); } .ds-settings-nav svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-settings-nav { width: auto; flex-direction: row; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 10px; border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--studio-border); } .ds-settings-nav button { min-height: 42px; flex: 1; justify-content: center; padding-inline: 8px; } }

components.name: Settings Content Row
components.description: Flat divider-led row with explanatory copy and one trailing control.
components.html:
Language

Choose the language used across Studio.
components.css: .ds-settings-row { min-height: 84px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(220px, 1fr) max-content; align-items: center; gap: 28px; padding-block: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--studio-border); color: var(--studio-text); font-family: var(--studio-font-sans); } .ds-settings-row strong { display: block; font-size: var(--studio-font-size-lg); line-height: 18px; } .ds-settings-row p { margin: 5px 0 0; color: var(--studio-text-secondary); font-size: var(--studio-font-size-md); line-height: 17px; } .ds-settings-row select { min-width: 190px; min-height: 34px; padding: 0 30px 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--studio-border); border-radius: var(--studio-radius-md); background: var(--studio-panel-raised); color: var(--studio-text); cursor: pointer; } .ds-settings-row select:hover { border-color: var(--studio-border-strong); } .ds-settings-row select:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--studio-focus); } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-settings-row { min-height: 0; grid-template-columns: 1fr; align-items: start; gap: 14px; padding-block: 16px 20px; } .ds-settings-row select { width: 100%; min-height: 40px; } }

components.name: Settings Theme Choice
components.description: Existing Studio radiogroup reused for theme choices.
components.css: .ds-settings-choice { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--studio-border); border-radius: var(--studio-radius-md); background: var(--studio-control); font-family: var(--studio-font-sans); } .ds-settings-choice button { min-width: 74px; min-height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--studio-radius-sm); background: transparent; color: var(--studio-text-secondary); font-size: var(--studio-font-size-sm); font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-settings-choice button:hover { color: var(--studio-text); } .ds-settings-choice button[aria-checked="true"] { background: var(--studio-panel-raised); color: var(--studio-accent); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(19 31 49 / 12%); } .ds-settings-choice button:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--studio-focus); } .ds-settings-choice button:active { transform: translateY(1px); } @media (max-width: 560px) { .ds-settings-choice { width: 100%; } .ds-settings-choice button { min-width: 0; min-height: 40px; flex: 1; } }

narrative.overview:
Studio should feel like a precise native developer workbench. It is compact, calm, and operational: browser-like draft tabs, dense tool rails, transparent workspace layers, focused modal tasks, and familiar controls keep the plugin preview visually primary.

This contract records the shared Studio palette, type ramp, shape scale, and depth vocabulary. The settings components are the first fully documented surface; they inherit the same tokens, theme behavior, internationalization, and responsive control geometry as the surrounding workbench.

rules.name: The Theme Inheritance Rule
rules.body: Settings must consume existing Studio color primitives; do not introduce a settings-only palette or hard-code a single theme.

rules.name: The Utility Type Rule
rules.body: Keep settings copy within the existing Studio type scale; do not add a display face or marketing-sized headings to this dialog.

rules.name: The Orientation Matches Geometry Rule
rules.body: Vertical navigation uses up/down arrows and `aria-orientation="vertical"`; horizontal navigation uses left/right arrows and `aria-orientation="horizontal"`. Home and End remain available in both modes.

rules.name: The Modal-Only Lift Rule
rules.body: Elevate the dialog as a whole; keep internal settings content flat and divider-led.

rules.name: The Flat Rows Rule
rules.body: Settings rows are sections divided by rules, not individually rounded cards.

rules.name: The Reuse Rule
rules.body: Settings must use the existing icon-button, select, theme, locale registry, and localization primitives instead of creating parallel variants.

rules.name: The Mobile Reach Rule
rules.body: Interactive settings controls must provide 40–42px targets at widths up to 560px without inflating the desktop density.

dos: Do preserve the existing Studio shell, theme tokens, type scale, focus treatment, and localization path.
Do keep the title bar restrained and the content rows flat, scannable, and separated by dividers.
Do change both keyboard semantics and hit areas when navigation changes orientation at 560px.
Do keep icons paired with localized labels in navigation, even when the toolbar entry point is icon-only.
donts: Don't turn settings into a separate visual world, branded landing surface, or stack of floating cards.
Don't use desktop-sized 28–34px interactive targets on the narrow layout.
Don't rotate navigation visually without also updating `aria-orientation`, arrow-key behavior, and focus movement.
Don't duplicate theme or language state outside the existing primitives.
